application_makefile:
.PHONY: all clean build_clean

APP_VERSION := $(shell cat ../BaseBin/_external/basebin/.version)-$(shell cat ../BaseBin/_external/basebin/.version-roothide)

all: Dopamine.ipa

Dopamine.ipa: build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Dopamine.app
	@echo Ad-Hoc signing Dopamine
	xattr -rc build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Dopamine.app
	ldid -SDopamine/Dopamine.entitlements build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Dopamine.app/Dopamine
	ldid -s build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Dopamine.app
	rm -rf Payload Dopamine.ipa
	mkdir Payload
	cp -r build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Dopamine.app Payload/Dopamine.app
	zip -Ar Dopamine.ipa Payload
	rm -rf Payload
	rm -rf Dopamine.tipa
	cp Dopamine.ipa Dopamine.tipa
	mv Dopamine.ipa Dopamine-roothide-"$(APP_VERSION)".ipa
	mv Dopamine.tipa Dopamine-roothide-"$(APP_VERSION)".tipa

ifeq ($(NIGHTLY), 1)
build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Dopamine.app: FORCE
	xcodebuild -scheme Dopamine -derivedDataPath build -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO GCC_PREPROCESSOR_DEFINITIONS='NIGHTLY=1 COMMIT_HASH=\"$(COMMIT_HASH)\"'
else
build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Dopamine.app: FORCE
	xcodebuild -scheme Dopamine -derivedDataPath build -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO
endif
	touch build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Dopamine.app/Dopamine.roothide
	cp -a Dopamine/Resources/*.deb build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Dopamine.app/
	cp ../BaseBin/.build/libroothider.dylib build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Dopamine.app/
	plutil -replace CFBundleIdentifier -string "com.opa334.Dopamine-roothide" build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Dopamine.app/Info.plist
	plutil -replace CFBundleShortVersionString -string "$(APP_VERSION)" build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Dopamine.app/Info.plist
# ifeq ($(PALEHIDE), 1)
	make -C Dopamine/Exploits/palera1n package
	cp -a Dopamine/Exploits/palera1n/.framework build/Build/Products/Debug-iphoneos/Dopamine.app/Frameworks/palera1n.framework
# endif


clean:
	make -C Dopamine/Exploits/palera1n clean
	rm -rf build Payload Dopamine.ipa Dopamine.tipa

build_clean:
	rm -rf Payload build

FORCE: ;
info_serialization:
#define SYSTEM_INFO_SERIALIZE_COMPONENT(xdict, name) XPC_SET_GENERIC(xdict, #name, gSystemInfo.name)
#define SYSTEM_INFO_SERIALIZE(xdict) SYSTEM_INFO_ITERATE(xdict, SYSTEM_INFO_SERIALIZE_COMPONENT)

#define SYSTEM_INFO_DESERIALIZE_COMPONENT(xdict, name) XPC_GET_GENERIC(xdict, #name, gSystemInfo.name)
#define SYSTEM_INFO_DESERIALIZE(xdict) SYSTEM_INFO_ITERATE(xdict, SYSTEM_INFO_DESERIALIZE_COMPONENT)
normalization: UTF-8 source is compared after BOM/CRLF to Git-LF normalization; binary bytes remain exact
systemhook_makefile:
TARGET = systemhook.dylib
CC = clang

CFLAGS = -I../.include -I./src -I../_external/modules/litehook/src -isysroot $(shell xcrun --sdk iphoneos --show-sdk-path) -arch arm64 -arch arm64e -miphoneos-version-min=15.0 -install_name @loader_path/$(TARGET) -Wno-deprecated-declarations -D BUILD_STANDALONE=$(BUILD_STANDALONE) -Os -moutline
LDFLAGS = -dynamiclib

all: roothider_inline.o $(TARGET) sign

roothider_inline.o: src/roothider_inline.x
	@$(CC) -nostdlib -I../.include -isysroot $(shell xcrun --sdk iphoneos --show-sdk-path) \
	 -arch arm64 -arch arm64e -miphoneos-version-min=15.0 -Wno-deprecated-declarations \
	 -fno-stack-protector -fno-stack-check -fno-builtin -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -O2 \
	 -MMD -MP -MF $(@:.o=.d) -MT $@ \
	 -x c -c -o $@ $<
	@UNDEF=$$(nm -u -j $@ 2>/dev/null | sed '/^[[:space:]]*$$/d; / (for architecture [^)]*):$$/d'); \
	if [ -n "$$UNDEF" ]; then \
		echo "FAIL: $@ has undefined symbols:"; \
		echo "$$UNDEF"; \
		rm -f $@; \
		exit 1; \
	fi
	@echo "PASS: $@ is self-contained"

sign: $(TARGET)
	@install_name_tool -id $(TARGET) $(TARGET)
	@ldid -Cadhoc -S $^

$(TARGET): $(wildcard src/*.[cSm] src/common/*.[cSm] ../libjailbreak/src/jbclient_*.c ../libjailbreak/src/inline_svc.[cS] ../libjailbreak/src/hookd.c ../_external/modules/litehook/src/*.c)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(LDFLAGS) -o $@ $^

$(TARGET): ../libroothider/src/jailbreakd.c roothider_inline.o

clean:
	@rm -f $(TARGET)
	@rm -f roothider_inline.o roothider_inline.d

-include roothider_inline.d
